steps.text: Whisk 1 cup flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, pinch of salt.
In another bowl whisk 1 cup milk, 1 egg, 2 tbsp melted butter.
Pour wet into dry. Stir until just combined. Lumps are fine.
Heat a pan on medium. Add a little butter.
Pour 1/4 cup batter. Flip when bubbles pop on top.
Cook the second side until golden.
Repeat with the rest. Serve warm.

title: Set up a new user laptop

steps.text: Check the asset tag matches the ticket. Photo the serial label.
Plug in power and network. Power on.
Sign in with the setup account and join the domain / Intune.
Run Windows Update until nothing is left.
Install the standard app bundle from Company Portal.
Sign in to Adobe Sign once to create the profile.
Check BitLocker is on and the key is escrowed.
Update the asset record with owner and date. Close the ticket.
